propositions: Reconciler core currently calls Jira adapter directly with no abstracted Backend interface for a second vendor implementation to implement

Five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and three runtime-checkable capability Protocols must be defined in _backend.py with RemoteRef dataclass for vendor/instance/remote_id identity

JiraBackend must be a thin delegation wrapper over existing Jira modules (AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields, jira_fields sanitizers) that preserves exact current behavior with zero logic relocation

IdentityConvention must extract and unify the rebar-id:{local_id} label format currently inlined at four core call sites (dispatch_one.py:320, binding_store.py:516, apply_inbound_records.py:223, binding_walk.py:341) into a new pure convention object under adapters/jira/identity.py

Backend-agnostic contract suite must execute against both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend, validating outbound/inbound round-trips, sanitizer idempotence, and capability-detection via isinstance() dispatch

Characterization tests must assert pure Jira mapper outputs (outbound map, inbound extract, ADF text fit) match byte-for-byte pre-story main behavior on representative fixtures, with zero core differ/apply modules modified
